title: A Gentle Journey to Calm

steps.text: Welcome, Blanca. Let's begin by finding a comfortable position, sitting or lying down. Gently close your eyes if that feels good for you. Take a slow, deep breath in through your nose, filling your lungs completely.
Now, slowly exhale through your mouth, letting go of any tension you might be holding. Feel your body begin to soften and relax with each breath. Let your shoulders drop away from your ears.
Bring your attention to the natural rhythm of your breathing. Notice the gentle rise and fall of your chest and belly. There is no need to change anything, just observe this peaceful flow.
With each breath, imagine a wave of calm washing over you, starting at the top of your head and slowly moving down through your body. Feel your scalp, forehead, and face soften and relax.
Allow this calm wave to flow down your neck and shoulders, releasing any tightness or heaviness. Let your arms feel light and loose, resting comfortably by your sides.
Feel the calmness continue down through your chest and back. With every breath out, imagine any stress melting away, leaving a sense of ease and peace.
Now, bring your awareness to your abdomen. Notice it rising gently as you breathe in, and falling softly as you breathe out. Feel the steady, soothing rhythm calming your whole being.
Let the wave of calm travel down your hips, thighs, and knees. Imagine your legs becoming heavy and relaxed, supported fully by the surface beneath you.
Finally, feel the calmness reach your feet and toes. Sense your entire body wrapped in a gentle, peaceful embrace, grounded and serene.
Take a moment to simply be here, in this calm space. If your mind wanders, gently bring your focus back to your breath and the soothing sensations in your body.
When you feel ready, begin to deepen your breath again. Wiggle your fingers and toes softly, bringing gentle movement back to your body.
Slowly open your eyes, carrying this calm and peaceful feeling with you throughout your day. Remember, this calm is always available to you whenever you need it.

safety_note: This session is designed for relaxation and is not a substitute for professional medical or mental health care. If you experience any discomfort or distress, please pause and seek appropriate support.
